summary: The diff implements most of the requested features: shareable copy-link buttons on PostCard and PostDetailPage (REQ-2), a preview/teaser login gate for unauthenticated users on PostDetailPage (REQ-3), the post detail route made publicly accessible (REQ-4 frontend side), and the 'Create Post' nav link visible to all authenticated users (REQ-1 frontend). However, there is no evidence of backend changes to remove admin/owner restrictions on post creation (REQ-1 backend AC) or to allow anonymous callers to call getPost without authentication (REQ-4 backend AC). The diff is entirely frontend-only.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend allows any authenticated principal to call the create post function (remove admin/owner-only restriction on the backend)
missing_requirements.reason: The diff contains only frontend changes. No backend Motoko/Rust/Candid files were modified to remove the admin/owner check on post creation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Unauthenticated (anonymous) callers can retrieve a published post by ID from the backend; Draft and hidden posts remain inaccessible to unauthenticated users
missing_requirements.reason: No backend files were modified in the diff. The backend getPost function's access control allowing anonymous callers for published posts while blocking drafts/hidden posts is not shown to have been changed.
